package: "openpipeline"
version: "v4.2.0"
title: "create_pseudobulk"
subtitle: "openpipeline v4.2.0"
toc: true
namespace: "Differential expression"
description: "Generation of pseudobulk samples from single-cell transcriptomics data, by aggregating raw gene expression counts from individual cells to create bulk-like expression profiles suitable for differential expression analysis with methods designed for bulk differential expression analysis. Note that this componentonly considers factors as explanatory variables, and excludes covariates from the analysis."
type: "module"
latest: "true"

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/differential_expression/create_pseudobulk/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/differential_expression/create_pseudobulk);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/differential_expression/create_pseudobulk/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
